newsitem.title: GERMANY: CDU's Hintze optimistic Germany to meet EMU goals.
newsitem.headline: CDU's Hintze optimistic Germany to meet EMU goals.

text.p: Peter Hintze, general secretary of Chancellor Helmut Kohl's Christian Democrats (CDU) said on Thursday he was confident Germany would meet the criteria for membership of currency union in 1997.

"There is no reason to get excited, Germany will fulfil the (Maastricht) criteria," Hintze said on German television. He went on to call for a strict interpretation of the criteria, which would help build fiscal stability after currency union.
If these criteria were to be relaxed, then the anchor of fiscal stability would not longer function, Hintze said.
He added that the German government would formulate the budget to make meeting the criteria possible.
